title: Puncture localization identifies H¹ with derived torsion
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative Noetherian local ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], $\mathfrak m$ its maximal ideal, and $W$ an open of $X=\operatorname{Spec}R$ [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] containing exactly the points other than the closed point. There is an additive equivalence $H^1(W,\mathcal O_W)\cong R^2\Gamma_{\mathfrak m}(R)$, where the left side is Modules.H of the unit structure module and $\Gamma_{\mathfrak m}$ is the functor [def-sbc-ideal-power-torsion-functor].

proof.text: Choose an injective resolution I of R. Construct the explicit monic torsion subcomplex inclusion f, and use the puncture comparison to identify H¹(W,O_W) with H¹(coker f).

ShortComplex.cokernelSequence_exact and componentwise injectivity make the cokernel sequence short exact. InjectiveResolution.cocomplex_exactAt_succ makes H¹(I) and H²(I) zero. Apply ShortComplex.ShortExact.δIso in degrees one and two to get H¹(coker f) isomorphic to H²(Gamma_m(I)).

InjectiveResolution.isoRightDerivedObj identifies H²(Gamma_m(I)) with the second right derived torsion functor on R. Convert both module isomorphisms to additive equivalences and compose with the puncture comparison.
